audit.why: 54.71% over 923 games at EVEN 6/10 fits a lane Pantheon can cheese at 1-2 and loses from 3 onward.

audit.whatIsWrong: Both layers read Skill, Olaf, Olaf, Skill, Skill, Olaf, Olaf. That hands Olaf level 2 while the why underneath says the lane only evens out there, and calls levels 4-5 and level 6 coin flips when the prose says Olaf out-sustains the poke and that Ragnarok answers Shield Vault. Level 1 is marked neutral while whys[0] says outright that Pantheon owns it.
audit.why: Pantheon's strength is concentrated at levels 1-2 and evaporates from 3; the chart had the shape roughly inverted at both ends.
audit.corrected: Chart re-proposed as one atomic group across both layers: Pantheon, Skill, Olaf, Olaf, Olaf, Olaf, Olaf, with ratings moved on the rows that changed hands.

audit.whatIsWrong: A mechanic that does not exist is asserted five times: 'his passive still blocks autos', 'his auto-block passive does nothing', 'his passive blocks your autos so your raw trades feel weak', 'his passive shield can't block', 'block your autos with his passive shield'. Mortal Will is 'every few spells or attacks, Pantheon's next spell is empowered' — it does not block anything. The blocking is Aegis Assault (E), a 22s channel that is invulnerable to damage from the front only. Separately, 'Sit low for his W execute' invents an execute on Shield Vault, which is a dash-stun. And 'R cleanses it' misstates Ragnarok, which is immunity to disables held while attacking, not a cleanse.
audit.why: A player who believes Pantheon's passive blocks autos will avoid auto-trading he actually wins, and will not learn the real interaction: Aegis Assault blocks from the front, so you walk around it, and Shield Vault is a dash toward you, so Undertow's slow never lets him leave.
audit.corrected: Every auto-block reference re-attributed to Aegis Assault with its 22s cooldown and front-only condition. The phantom Shield Vault execute removed. Ragnarok restated as immunity held while attacking, with the sequencing corrected to press it as Shield Vault lands. Comet Spear given its 575 range, Shield Vault its 13s, Grand Starfall named as the global.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'Track Shield Vault' appears eight times with no number.
audit.why: Shield Vault at 13s rank 1 is the trade-deciding cooldown and Aegis Assault at 22s is the longest gap in his kit.
audit.corrected: 13s and 22s written into the cooldown breakdown, the interactions line and the all-in window.

audit.why: The content layer already has the right win condition — survive 1-2, take over from 3, close before Grand Starfall turns him into a roaming flank.
audit.corrected: Reinforced in winCon rather than changed.

edits.before: Pantheon is the one window where you have to be careful — at levels 1-2 his W point-click stun into an empowered Q spear can chunk you before your E true damage and W sustain are online, and his passive blocks your autos so your raw trades feel weak. Don't walk into a level-1 stun-lock; farm the wave and wait for your spike. The moment you hit 3 with Q plus E, the lane flips: land Q to stick the slow, walk in, and E for guaranteed true damage that his passive shield can't block.
edits.after: Pantheon is the one window where you have to be careful — at levels 1-2 Shield Vault's point-click stun into an empowered Comet Spear can chunk you before Reckless Swing and Vicious Strikes are online. Don't walk into a level-1 stun-lock; farm the wave and wait for your spike. The moment you hit 3, the lane flips: land Undertow to stick the slow, walk in, and Reckless Swing for true damage no shield of his reduces — Aegis Assault only blocks what comes at his front.

edits.before: This is your lane now. His Q poke can't out-damage your W-omnivamp in any extended trade, and once you stick a Q-slow he has no dash to escape your E. At 6 your Ragnarok is the dagger — it removes and immunizes his W stun, the one tool his whole all-in relies on, so pop R and run him down or dive him under tower. With Bramble or Black Cleaver coming online you are at your most oppressive while he's already starting to fall off.
edits.after: This is your lane now. Comet Spear poke can't out-damage Vicious Strikes in any extended trade, and once Undertow sticks he has no dash away — Shield Vault only jumps toward you. At 6 Ragnarok is the dagger: immunity to his stun for as long as you keep attacking, so press it as he vaults in and run him down or dive him under tower. With Bramble or Black Cleaver online you are at your most oppressive while he's already falling off.

notes: The headline error: the page asserts five times that Pantheon's passive blocks auto-attacks. Mortal Will empowers his next spell every few casts or attacks and blocks nothing — the block is Aegis Assault (E), a 22s channel invulnerable to damage from the FRONT only, which is a positional interaction the page never mentioned. It also invented an execute on Shield Vault ('Sit low for his W execute'); Shield Vault is a dash-stun. Both fixed. 'R cleanses it' corrected to Ragnarok's actual wording — immunity to disables held while attacking — with the sequencing changed to press it as Shield Vault lands rather than after. Level chart flipped four rows in matched pairs; the old chart marked level 1 neutral while the prose beneath it said Pantheon owns level 1 outright. KIT FLAG MISFIRE: olaf.json tags Undertow with grounding, which would matter here against two dashes, but Riot's Undertow text is damage plus Armor and Move Speed reduction only — no grounding claim written.
